item: R741: a swap refused because the library is held ends quickly; repair keeps its copy (rows 143, 145)
summary: Windows: after a 5 s grace a bounded psutil probe (2 s) asks whether this process holds the refused file; only a positive answer refuses early as LibraryBusy, anything else keeps the 300 s wait. Repair: held file = writer-busy, finished copy kept, completes at next start. Encrypt: fixed words x12, 'untouched' only when nothing was removed. POSIX unchanged (winerror 32/33 only).
